C_COD_NAMES_THE_MISCOMPUTATION.rationale: The candidate clearly explains the exact nature of the miscomputation (calculating the discount amount rather than price owed, charging 20% instead of 80%), far exceeding level 3, but falls short of level 5 because it does not explicitly state who loses money.
